A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

MMC is a safe and effective treatment to prevent synechia after functional endoscopic sinus surgeries, but it should be used with caution in patients with asthma and/or nasal polyps, because of the risk of postoperative complications, and that it does not influence the success rate of functional endoscopic sinus surgical procedures.
the authors demonstrated that a well-performed FESS for the treatment of CRS is able to obtain a high success rate independently of the adoption or not of MMC.

The main takeaway from our work is that
MMC does not improve the success of FESS in patients with chronic rhinosinus-itis, and that the success rates of the procedure are not influenced by MMC, but rather by the surgical technique.
mitomycin C may be a useful adjunctive therapy for FESS in patients with chronic rhinosinusitus.
